summary: Iteration 2 backend + frontend verification for Consentalk. 54/54 backend pytest cases pass (36 existing + 18 new for OTP, invite-by-phone, leave room, read-receipt auto-delete, /users/{id} access control, WS end + screenshot relay). Frontend smoke verified end-to-end: country typeahead picker, OTP request/verify with dev_code banner, summon results card with leave-room button, chat msg-input Enter-to-send, invite modal email/phone toggle, screenshot/invite/force-exit header buttons.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~1191 lines — exceeds the 700-line guideline. Recommend splitting into routers/ (auth.py, profile.py, rooms.py, messages.py, admin.py, ws.py) for maintainability.

Phone OTP is intentionally MOCKED — dev_code is returned in response. Document this clearly in API docs and ensure prod build replaces /api/profile/phone/request-otp implementation with a real SMS gateway (Twilio/Resend) before launch.
WebSocket auth still uses query-string token (?token=...) — token can leak via proxy logs. Acceptable for MVP, flag for production hardening (use first WS message handshake or cookie).
/api/users/{user_id} treats admin/super_admin as bypass for the shared-room rule — sensible for moderation but ensure admin audit log captures reads if PII expectations tighten.
Forensic 'encryption' in encrypt_fragment is base64 placeholder — already noted in iteration 1; still applies.

success_rate.frontend: 100% smoke (verify typeahead+OTP, summon→leave-room card, chat Enter-send, invite email/phone toggle, screenshot/invite/force-exit header buttons)

Frontend smoke seeded a user via mongosh: user_id=fe_user_1778300503167, session_token=fe_test_1778300503167 (active, role=user, name=FE Tester2). One persistent test room created via API: room_917a57406c8441 (owner=fe_user_1778300503167, phrase='silver ocean tonight', pin='4242') — used to validate the summon→leave-room→chat path. Safe to leave or drop; all TEST_ prefixed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: `pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v -o asyncio_mode=auto --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml`. The ws tests in test_iteration2_features.py require pytest-asyncio (already installed) and the `websockets` package (in requirements.txt). For frontend, set localStorage 'consentalk.session_token' to a seeded token then navigate to /verify, /(tabs), or /room/{id}. testID conventions: country picker uses verify-country/country-search-input/country-row-{ISO2}; phone uses verify-phone (NOT verify-phone-input); chat uses msg-input/send-btn/screenshot-btn/invite-btn/force-exit-btn/avatar-{user_id}/member-name/member-report; summon results use room-card-{id}/leave-room-{id}; invite modal uses invite-mode-email/invite-mode-phone. Avatar testID only appears on OTHER members' messages; to validate that flow you need a second user posting in the same room.
rca_of_issue: No bugs found in iteration 2. The previously reported risk-score escalation bug (iteration 1) has been fixed — test_report_escalation now passes.
